Qualitative, quantitative, observation & interpretation定性、定量、观察与解释

Your lab partner writes "the reaction is exothermic" under Observations. On this test that line loses marks — it is an interpretation. Knowing which box each sentence belongs in is free marks.实验搭档在「观察」一栏写了「这个反应是放热反应」。考试里这句会被扣分——它是解释，不是观察。分清每句话该放哪一栏，就是白拿的分。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 25 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Qualitative, quantitative, observation & interpretation定性、定量、观察与解释
  1. Qualitative = senses, no numbers. Quantitative = measured or counted numbers.定性＝感官，无数字。定量＝测量或计数的数字。
  2. Observation = qualitative, sensed directly. Interpretation = what it means, not directly seen.观察＝定性、直接感知。解释＝它意味着什么，看不见。
  3. Description = properties in words and numbers, so it can be both.描述＝用文字和数字列性质，可以两者兼有。
Observation 观察
👀 seen, heard, smelled, felt 用感官得到
e.g. bubbles formed 例：冒出气泡
heat was released 放出了热量
vs
Interpretation 解释
💭 explains what it means 解释它意味着什么
e.g. a gas was produced 例：生成了气体
the reaction is exothermic 反应放热

Qualitative vs quantitative定性与定量

Qualitative 定性
🎨 words, no numbers 用文字描述，没有数字
the solution is blue 溶液是蓝色
the metal is shiny 金属有光泽
vs
Quantitative 定量
🔢 numbers and units 有数字和单位
mass is 12.5 g 质量是 12.5 g
temperature rose by 8 °C 温度升高了 8 °C

🧗 The hard part难点 · Qualitative, quantitative, observation & interpretation定性、定量、观察与解释

Splitting one sentence into observation + interpretation把一句话拆成观察＋解释

Real sentences mix what was sensed and what was concluded.真实句子里「感觉到的」和「推断出的」混在一起。

  1. Cut the sentence at "so" / "because".在「所以／因为」处切开。
  2. For each piece: could I see, hear, smell or feel it? Yes → observation.每一段问：能看到、听到、闻到、摸到吗？能→观察。
  3. Needs a chemistry idea (reaction, exothermic, gas name)? → interpretation.需要化学概念（反应、放热、气体名称）？→解释。
Try试一试
Split: "The test tube got hot, so the reaction is exothermic."拆分：「试管变热了，所以反应是放热的。」
Answer答案
Observation: the test tube got hot. Interpretation: the reaction is exothermic.观察：试管变热。解释：反应是放热的。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Qualitative, quantitative, observation & interpretation定性、定量、观察与解释
  • "4 beakers" is qualitative → it is a count, so quantitative.「4 个烧杯」是定性 → 计数，是定量。
  • "A gas was produced" is an observation → interpretation; "bubbles formed" is the observation.「产生了气体」是观察 → 是解释；「出现气泡」才是观察。
🟡
Your class notes say an observation must be qualitative (measurements count as quantitative data, not observations). Many textbooks call measurements "quantitative observations". On this test use the class version: observation = qualitative.课堂讲义规定观察必须是定性的（测量得到的数字算定量数据，不算观察）。很多教材把测量叫作「定量观察」。考试按讲义：观察＝定性。
🎯
Circle numbers first; then split sentences at "so" or "because".先圈数字；再在「所以／因为」处拆句。

cards.f: Qualitative vs quantitative?定性与定量的区别？
cards.b: Qualitative: no numbers, senses. Quantitative: numbers from measuring or counting.定性：无数字，靠感官。定量：测量或计数得到的数字。

cards.f: Observation (class definition)?观察（讲义定义）？
cards.b: Qualitative information gathered with your senses. Must be qualitative.用感官得到的定性信息。必须是定性的。

cards.f: Interpretation?解释？
cards.b: An explanation of what an observation means — based on evidence, not directly seen.说明观察意味着什么——有证据支撑，但看不见。

cards.f: Which statement type can be both qualitative and quantitative?哪类说法可以同时是定性和定量的？
cards.b: A description (lists properties with words and numbers).描述（用文字和数字列出性质）。

cards.f: Trap: "The reaction is exothermic because heat was released."陷阱：「因为放出热量，所以是放热反应。」
cards.b: "Heat was released" = observation; "exothermic" = interpretation.「放出热量」＝观察；「放热反应」＝解释。

quiz.q: Qualitative or quantitative: "The flame turned bright orange."定性还是定量：「火焰变成了亮橙色。」
quiz.hint: Is there any number?有没有数字？
quiz.ans: Qualitative定性
quiz.why: Colour is seen with your eyes and has no number → qualitative.颜色用眼睛看，没有数字→定性。

quiz.q: Qualitative or quantitative: "The solution reached 37.5 °C."定性还是定量：「溶液温度达到 37.5 °C。」
opts: Qualitative定性
Quantitative定量
Observation观察
Interpretation解释
quiz.hint: It came from a thermometer.这个数来自温度计。
quiz.ans: Quantitative定量
quiz.why: 37.5 °C is a measured number → quantitative.37.5 °C 是测量出的数字→定量。

quiz.q: Observation or interpretation: "A popping sound was heard when the splint was lit."观察还是解释：「点燃木条时听到『噗』的一声。」
quiz.hint: Which sense was used? Is anything explained?用了哪种感官？有没有解释什么？
quiz.ans: Observation观察
quiz.why: The sound is heard directly → observation (qualitative).声音是直接听到的→观察（定性）。

quiz.q: In "The liquid turned cloudy, so a precipitate formed", which part is the interpretation?在「液体变浑浊了，所以生成了沉淀」中，哪一部分是解释？
quiz.hint: Split at the word "so".在「所以」处拆开。
quiz.ans: "A precipitate formed" is the interpretation; "turned cloudy" is the observation.「生成了沉淀」是解释；「变浑浊」是观察。
quiz.why: "Turned cloudy" — seen → observation.「变浑浊」——看得到→观察。

quiz.q: Which statement is an interpretation?哪一句是解释？
opts: The gas has no smell这种气体没有气味
The metal is shiny这种金属有光泽
Carbon dioxide gas was produced产生了二氧化碳气体
Fizzing was heard听到了嘶嘶声
quiz.hint: Which one needs chemistry knowledge, not just your senses?哪一句需要化学知识而不只是感官？
quiz.ans: Carbon dioxide gas was produced产生了二氧化碳气体
quiz.why: Smell, shine and sound are sensed directly → observations.气味、光泽、声音是直接感知的→观察。

quiz.q: Is "The copper wire is reddish-brown and 15.0 cm long" an observation or a description? Explain in one sentence.「铜丝是红棕色的，长 15.0 cm」是观察还是描述？用一句话说明。
quiz.hint: Can an observation contain a number in this class?本课的观察可以含数字吗？
quiz.ans: Description — it lists properties with both words (reddish-brown) and a number (15.0 cm); an observation must be qualitative only.描述——它同时用文字（红棕色）和数字（15.0 cm）列出性质；观察只能是定性的。
quiz.why: Colour = qualitative, 15.0 cm = quantitative → both.颜色＝定性，15.0 cm＝定量→两者都有。

quiz.q: Rewrite "The reaction is endothermic" as an observation a student could actually make.把「这个反应是吸热反应」改写成学生真正能观察到的一句话。
quiz.hint: Endothermic reactions take in heat from the surroundings.吸热反应从周围吸收热量。
quiz.ans: For example: "The beaker felt cold to the touch." (no numbers, only senses)例如：「烧杯摸起来变凉了。」（无数字，只用感官）
quiz.why: "Endothermic" is an interpretation.「吸热反应」是解释。

quiz.q: A lab report says: (1) "The mass of the beaker was 80.0 g." (2) "The solution smelled sour." (3) "The solution is acidic because it smelled sour." (4) "The liquid is clear and has a volume of 25 mL." Label each: observation, interpretation, description, or quantitative (not an observation).实验报告写道：(1)「烧杯质量为 80.0 g。」(2)「溶液闻起来酸酸的。」(3)「因为闻起来酸，所以溶液是酸性的。」(4)「液体澄清，体积 25 mL。」给每句贴标签：观察、解释、描述，还是定量（不算观察）。
quiz.hint: Which ones have numbers? Which one gives a reason?哪几句有数字？哪一句在给理由？
quiz.ans: (1) quantitative (a measurement — data, not an observation); (2) observation; (3) interpretation; (4) description.(1) 定量（测量值——是数据，不是观察）；(2) 观察；(3) 解释；(4) 描述。
quiz.why: (1) 80.0 g is a measurement → quantitative.(1) 80.0 g 是测量值→定量。
